master.title: Priceable parts ({count})
master.hint: Each part has its own price and sales lines. Pick a part to view or change its price.

detail.title: Price details
detail.pickHint: Pick a part on the left to edit its price.

zeroCallout.title: Confirm free price
zeroCallout.message: The sales price of this activity is € 0.00. Confirm that this activity is deliberately carried out for free, or adjust the price.

order.zeroConfirmMessage: You are setting the agreed price of order {number} to € 0.00. Confirm that this order is deliberately free.

picker.lockedWhileDirty: Save the sales lines or discard the changes to switch activity.

activity.readOnlyNoPermission: You are not allowed to change activity prices.
activity.readOnlyClosed: The dossier is closed; the price is read-only.
activity.freeConfirmed: This activity is confirmed as free (€ 0).
activity.previewHint: The amounts are a preview (quantity × unit price). After saving, the server's amounts and total apply.
activity.linesSaveFailed: The sales lines could not be saved.
activity.quantityInvalid: Line {index}: enter a quantity greater than zero.
activity.unitPriceInvalid: Line {index}: enter a valid unit price (0 or more).
activity.noRowsToSave: Add at least one sales line, or use "Remove price" to clear the price.
activity.conflict: This price was changed by a colleague in the meantime. The latest version has been loaded; your unsaved lines are still here. Check them and save again.
activity.conflictReloadFailed: This price was changed by a colleague in the meantime. Your unsaved lines are still here; reload the dossier and then save again.
activity.flatReplacesLines: Saving a fixed price replaces the sales lines of this activity.
activity.linesReplaceFlat: Saving sales lines replaces the fixed price: the total of the lines becomes the price of this activity.
activity.confirmFreeMessage: The existing price and all sales lines of this activity are removed. The activity is confirmed as free (€ 0).
activity.removePriceMessage: The price and all sales lines of {name} will be removed. This part is then not priced.
activity.actionFailed: The price could not be updated.

goodsLink.label: Relates to goods
goodsLink.hint: Optional. Nothing ticked = the line applies to the whole trip or activity.
goodsLink.noReasonNeeded: Not needed when you only change the goods link.

goodsCoverage.title: Goods price coverage
goodsCoverage.includedHint: A goods line that is included in a fixed trip or activity price is not invoiced separately.

postExecution.agreementClosed: This order is already planned or executed: an agreed price is no longer possible. The price now goes through the sales lines.
postExecution.freeClosed: Free is only possible before planning, or after execution for a failed delivery with a redelivery.
postExecution.freeExplain: A failed delivery and its redelivery are one transport. Confirm as free whatever is not charged separately.
postExecution.needsRight: A planner or administrator with price rights decides this on the order.
postExecution.freeConfirmMessage: Order {number} is deliberately not charged (€ 0). Any sales lines and services of this order are dropped.
postExecution.freeFailed: The order could not be confirmed as free.

method.agreedHint: One fixed amount for this part.
method.freeHint: Deliberately carried out without a price.
method.freeExplain: This activity is deliberately free (€ 0). It counts as handled.
method.freeExplainOrder: Order {number} is deliberately free (€ 0). It counts as handled.

panel.confirmedUnpriced: Confirmed while not all goods had a tariff: {reason}
panel.staleWarning: Price outdated — the goods or conditions changed after the last calculation. Recalculate the price.
panel.coverageAgreed: These goods lines fall under the agreed trip price.
panel.coverageLocked: Not all goods had a tariff when the price was confirmed.
panel.coverageHint: Add a sales line for these goods, or agree a fixed trip price. You can also confirm with a reason.
panel.coveredByAgreed: covered by the agreed trip price
panel.fixedDescription: Use a fixed price instead of the calculated sales lines.
